Two-head proportion (2.0 to 2.2 heads tall), huge appealing head, short compact body, shoulder-length LIGHT NEUTRAL CREAM hair with two or three sculpted locks and a broad highlight band. At native resolution standing character is 48 pixels tall, head about 23 pixels tall. Eyes 2 by 3 native pixels with a single highlight pixel. Deliberate chunky pixel clusters, consistent square pixel grid, native 1-pixel colored outline: warm dark taupe around hair and dark navy around metal and blue cloth. Clean 3-step ramps, maximum 32 colors. No dithering, gradients, blur, anti-aliasing, soft shadows, tiny noisy details or realistic painting. Thick luminous ivory center with light ice-blue stepped rim, native 4 to 6 pixel thickness at widest point, tapered at ends. Keep face and core costume unobscured. Blade visible at lower/front end of arc and held in extended gloved hand, anatomically coherent arm connected at shoulder. This is impact, not overhead wind-up, no disembodied blade. Both figures same anatomical scale: idle 48 native pixels high rendered as approximately 12x nearest-neighbor blocks (~576 output pixels high); pose including crescent ~64 native pixels high. Paint every logical pixel as an equally sized 12x12 square. No captions, text, numbers, gridlines, borders, ground, shadows, extra characters.

Warm ivory and cool silver balanced harmoniously. Refined appealing high-quality commercial Korean pixel RPG sprite craftsmanship.

Native one pixel colored dark outlines, clean three-tone color clusters. 28 colors total, each pixel cell a flat single color. ZERO soft bloom or glow: swoosh has clean solid ivory center and solid icy-blue edge, thick bold crescent arcing from back above head into open front and ENDING ON sword at lower right. NO translucent pixels, NO shadows, no ground, NO black backdrop, NO gradient background, no lighting haze. TRUE transparent background everywhere outside opaque pixel silhouettes. Exactly two figures side by side on landscape 1536x1024, left idle and right sword slash impact lunge as in source, same character and same scale. This is artisanal low-res pixel painting, not a pixelated illustration.
